description: Run a comprehensive clinical voice assessment in a single call. Executes AVQI, CPP, multi-band HNR, jitter/shimmer, and spectral analysis in parallel, then returns a unified JSON report with all metrics and clinical severity interpretation. AVQI version is derived automatically from the patient language (en/nl/de → v02.03; fr/es/it → v03.01). BEFORE CALLING: (1) Ask for or infer the patient language (en/fr/nl/es/de/it). (2) Show the user the correct connected speech reference sentence for that language (read vocametrix://recording-guide to get it) and ask them to record it. (3) Confirm they also have a sustained /a/ vowel recording of 5+ s. Only call once both recordings are confirmed ready.

connectedSpeechPath.description: Absolute path to connected speech WAV — patient reads the language-specific reference sentence (see vocametrix://recording-guide)

language.description: Patient language — determines AVQI version and the correct reference sentence

sustainedVowelPath.description: Absolute path to sustained vowel WAV (/a/ held 5+ s)
